resolutions.title: The verify walk clause names a next review that a passed system gate does not owe
resolutions.action: Made the clause gate-neutral: 'walk the outstanding review findings first', in VERIFY_WALK_CLAUSE, all five sites of the orbit-run-summary-emit delta (the pass text and scenario, the mode-② and warn texts, the fail-mode scenario), and the test's CLAUSE. On a passed system gate archive follows the walk, so the text no longer promises a review. The rc03b pin for emit-composition.ts moved, recorded.

resolutions.title: The fingerprint stamp in .openspec.yaml is outside every walk entry's edit record
resolutions.action: No edit. This entry records .openspec.yaml as the file the system walk changed: it carries the four base fingerprints stamped for the requirements that walk carried (Gate-aware status and instructions with position readout; Verify pass recommendation, Verify fail-mode recommendations and No forward-look at planned future behavior changes). `orbit fingerprint --check` verifies 7 of 7. The earlier walk log is a trail record and is not rewritten.

final_assessment: Three of three resolved: two gates.ts comments reworded to the gate-id test, the verify walk clause made gate-neutral, and the fingerprint stamp recorded.
